# Harlow and Finch benefits guide

Employee benefits for the plan year, from the HR portal.

## Enrolling and open enrollment

New hires have 30 days from their start date to enroll. Everyone else can change elections during open enrollment, November 1 to 15. Outside that window, only a qualifying life event, such as a marriage, a birth or loss of other coverage, lets you change.

## Medical, dental and vision

Three medical plans (a PPO, an HMO and a high-deductible plan). The company pays about 80% of the employee premium and 60% of the family premium. Dental has a $1,500 annual maximum; vision includes an exam and $150 toward frames each year.

## Savings and retirement

The company matches the 401(k): 100% of the first 3% of pay you contribute, plus 50% of the next 2%, so putting in 5% earns the full 4% match. New employees are enrolled automatically at 4% unless they opt out. Match money vests 20% a year, so it is fully yours after 5 years of service; your own contributions are always yours.

## Health savings account

Employees on the high-deductible plan get an HSA. The company puts in $500 a year for one person and $1,000 for a family. The account is yours: unspent money rolls over every year, earns interest, and goes with you if you leave. It can pay qualified medical, dental and vision costs for you, your spouse and your tax dependents, including braces and glasses.

## Flexible spending account

The health FSA lets you set aside up to $3,200 a year from pay before tax. It is use-it-or-lose-it: you can carry over only $640 into the next year, and what is left after the grace period is forfeited. A separate dependent-care FSA allows up to $5,000.

## Life and disability insurance

Basic life insurance of one times salary is free. You can buy extra life coverage up to five times salary. Short-term disability pays 60% of pay after 7 days, and long-term disability starts after 90 days.

## Time off

Fifteen vacation days to start, ten paid holidays and five sick days. Unused vacation up to 5 days carries over.
